entities.title: Handyman Jim
entities.summary: An original comedy game in Godot 4: a handyman in Marshfield, Wisconsin takes ridiculous repair jobs by phone, buys the parts, drives a too-fast van across town and fixes the mess before the customer gives up.
entities.purpose: Holds the whole Godot project: one scene (main.tscn) whose scripts in scripts/ build every screen in code, the content tables in scripts/data.gd, the web export preset, and the smoke and flow tests in tests/. It has no package.json, so the repository's workflows neither build nor deploy it.
boundaries: It does not use icelander.net's sign-in and has no Worker or high-score table; publishing it on the site is an open decision (decisions.json).
All art is drawn by code; optional replacement images go in art/rooms/ following ART_STYLE.md.
